educationalGoal: This practicum in applied business management is a compulsory course for third-year students. In this course, students will: (1) Use the case method to develop the analytical and planning skills needed to formulate a business strategy. (2) Participate in a business game intended to develop the analytical and planning skills needed to make a profit. (3) Implement their ideas and exercise their programming skills using Arduino.
advice:
This compulsory course uses the following:
1) Strategy planning in which students will review and analyze the strategies of ‘real’ companies and develop new strategies for these companies. (group activity)
Students will be required to create documents such as a strategic analysis report and devise a new strategic plan.
2) the YBG Bakery Game, a competitive business game accessible on the Internet, which serves as a review of the relationship between sales volume, costs and profit, and profit planning. (group activity)
  Students will be required to create documents such as financial reports, business operation reports, market mechanism reports, and game review reports.
3) Programming for an original system using Arduino. (individual activity)
Students will be required to implement their ideas via Arduino and give a presentation describing the implementation.

achievementLevels.ideal:
1) Review and analyze the strategy of a ‘real’ company based on published information such as financial reports, and formulate a creative strategy for the company.
2) Develop a profit plan and implement optimum operations according to the plan in the business game.
3) Produce a work of creative programming using Arduino based on original ideas.
achievementLevels.standard:
1) Review and analyze the strategy of a ‘real’ company based on news releases, and formulate a strategy for the company.
2) Develop a profit plan and implement operations in the business game.
3) Create a programming work using Arduino.

              This practicum in applied business management is a compulsory course for third-year students. In this course, students will: (1) Use the case method to develop the analytical and planning skills needed to formulate a business strategy. (2) Participate in a business game intended to develop the analytical and planning skills needed to make a profit. (3) Implement their ideas and exercise their programming skills using Arduino.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This compulsory course uses the following:
1) Strategy planning in which students will review and analyze the strategies of ‘real’ companies and develop new strategies for these companies. (group activity)
Students will be required to create documents such as a strategic analysis report and devise a new strategic plan.
2) the YBG Bakery Game, a competitive business game accessible on the Internet, which serves as a review of the relationship between sales volume, costs and profit, and profit planning. (group activity)
  Students will be required to create documents such as financial reports, business operation reports, market mechanism reports, and game review reports.
3) Programming for an original system using Arduino. (individual activity)
Students will be required to implement their ideas via Arduino and give a presentation describing the implementation.
